how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh zenodo --collection aortaseg60 --record 18147026 --include '^(Ven|Anev|Dissec|Old|Nat|Young)\.zip$', submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 6 zips by md5 and 60 _image.nii.gz to verify.
